title: One Method Does Not Fit All: A Large-Scale Benchmark of Imputation Methods for Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
abstract: arXiv:2603.24626v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables gene expression profiling at cellular resolution but is inherently affected by sparsity caused by dropout events, where expressed genes are recorded as zeros due to technical limitations. These dropout events distort gene expression distributions and compromise downstream analyses. To address this challenge, numerous traditional and deep learning (DL)-based imputation methods have been developed to detect dropout events and impute their true expression values. However, evaluations of these methods have largely been restricted to specific downstream tasks and limited datasets, and large-scale systematic comparisons under standardized benchmarking conditions are lacking. To fill this gap, we present a comprehensive framework that evaluates 16 imputation methods across 10 experimental protocols, 6 downstream tasks, and 30 benchmark datasets. translated_title: 一种方法并非适用于所有情况：单细胞RNA测序数据填补方法的大规模基准测试
translated_abstract: 单细胞RNA测序技术能够在细胞分辨率下进行基因表达谱分析，但其固有地受到由dropout事件导致的稀疏性影响，即由于技术限制，已表达的基因被记录为零。这些dropout事件会扭曲基因表达分布，并损害下游分析的效果。为应对这一挑战，众多传统方法和基于深度学习（DL）的填补方法已被开发出来，用于检测dropout事件并填补其真实表达值。然而，对这些方法的评估大多局限于特定的下游任务和有限的数据集，缺乏在标准化基准测试条件下的大规模系统性比较。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一个全面的评估框架，在10种实验方案、6个下游任务和30个基准数据集上对16种填补方法进行了评估。通过大量实验，我们系统地……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个大规模标准化基准测试框架，在10种实验方案、6个下游任务和30个数据集上系统评估了16种单细胞RNA测序数据填补方法，结果表明没有一种方法能够适用于所有场景。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first large-scale standardized benchmarking framework that systematically evaluates 16 imputation methods for scRNA-seq data across 10 experimental protocols, 6 downstream tasks, and 30 datasets, demonstrating that no single method fits all scenarios.
